name: Dropbox
description: Typed Dropbox API v2 files, folders, search, revision-aware transfers, sharing, accounts and quotas.

permissions.description: Fixed HTTPS Dropbox API/content API with externally issued OAuth bearer token. Explicit confirmed writes may upload, overwrite, share, move, delete and restore files. No filesystem, retries, refresh or listeners. Event ingress requires explicit administrator profiles, saved secret references and provider/relay setup. Installation never provisions subscriptions or executes trigger code.

definitions.documentation:
Dropbox List Folder: POST /2/files/list_folder. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Continue Folder Listing
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Continue Folder Listing: POST /2/files/list_folder/continue. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Get Latest Folder Cursor
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Latest Folder Cursor: POST /2/files/list_folder/get_latest_cursor. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Get Metadata
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Metadata: POST /2/files/get_metadata. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Search Files (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Search Files
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Search Files: POST /2/files/search_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.description: Dropbox Continue File Search
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Continue File Search: POST /2/files/search/continue_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Download File (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Download File
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Download File: POST /2/files/download. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Upload File (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Upload File
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Upload File: POST /2/files/upload. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/upload"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Finish Upload Session (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Finish Upload Session
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Finish Upload Session: POST /2/files/upload_session/finish. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/upload_session/finish"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Create Folder
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Create Folder: POST /2/files/create_folder_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/create_folder_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Copy File or Folder (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Copy File or Folder
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Copy File or Folder: POST /2/files/copy_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/copy_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Move File or Folder (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Move File or Folder
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Move File or Folder: POST /2/files/move_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/move_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Delete File or Folder (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Delete File or Folder
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Delete File or Folder: POST /2/files/delete_v2. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/delete_v2"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox List Revisions (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox List Revisions
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox List Revisions: POST /2/files/list_revisions. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.name: Dropbox Restore Revision (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox Restore Revision
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Restore Revision: POST /2/files/restore. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/restore"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Save Copy Reference: POST /2/files/copy_reference/save. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX files/copy_reference/save"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Create Shared Link: POST /2/sharing/create_shared_link_with_settings. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX sharing/create_shared_link_with_settings"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.description: Dropbox List Shared Links
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox List Shared Links: POST /2/sharing/list_shared_links. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Shared Link Metadata: POST /2/sharing/get_shared_link_metadata. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Modify Shared Link: POST /2/sharing/modify_shared_link_settings. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX sharing/modify_shared_link_settings"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Revoke Shared Link: POST /2/sharing/revoke_shared_link. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. Requires confirmWrites=true and confirmation="DROPBOX sharing/revoke_shared_link"; reconcile uncertain outcomes before repeating. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox List Shared Folders (Direct)
definitions.description: Dropbox List Shared Folders
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox List Shared Folders: POST /2/sharing/list_folders. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.description: Dropbox Get Current Account
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Current Account: POST /2/users/get_current_account. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. definitions.description: Dropbox Get Account
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Account: POST /2/users/get_account. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.description: Dropbox Get Space Usage
definitions.documentation:
Dropbox Get Space Usage: POST /2/users/get_space_usage. One bounded request, explicit cursors, no retries/redirects or URL following. OAuth token issuance/refresh external; DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN or tokenSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection.config and credentials.accessToken. Only selectUser team impersonation is supported, requires team_data.member and provider entitlement. Optional typed pathRoot applies to file/sharing calls, never users calls. No custom endpoints/admin impersonation. Total wall-clock deadline starts before profile/secrets, default 10s max30s, dispatch/final guards plus abort, bounded cleanup100ms. Strict UTF-16/UTF-8, 512KiB request, 1MiB JSON response, 256KiB content chunks,64KiB argument/metadata headers. Known fields projected; uint64 byte counts/offsets decimal strings preserve precision, upload offsets emitted as JSON integer tokens. Session operations are explicit; caller retains session ID and advances offset from confirmed byte counts; close=false before finish. Upload update mode requires rev; no automatic conflict handling. File/folder/deleted and account/quota unions retained; unmodeled response fields omitted. Links are returned only, never fetched. No longpoll/watchers, refresh, full-team management or external credentials. Sources: https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/all-endpoints https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-folder https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/upload https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/download https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/files/list-revisions https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/sharing/create-shared-link-with-settings https://docs.dropboxapi.com/dropbox-api/api-reference/user-endpoints/users/get-space-usage https://www.dropbox.com/developers/documentation/http/documentation https://developers.dropbox.com/dbx-team-files-guide https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/files.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/sharing.stone https://github.com/dropbox/dropbox-api-spec/blob/main/users.stone

definitions.name: Dropbox Account Changed Event
definitions.description: Typed event emitted by Dropbox Account Changed.
definitions.documentation: Event output contract for Dropbox Account Changed. Use HMAC-SHA256, X-Dropbox-Signature, empty prefix and app secret, with GET query challenge named challenge. The payload identifies accounts needing files/list_folder/continue synchronization, not file paths or actions. No hint deduplication: identical account arrays can represent different changes. Filter by accountId if desired.

ingressRequirements.name: Dropbox signed account change hints
ingressRequirements.description: Direct raw-body hex HMAC-SHA256 and exact Dropbox GET challenge echo.
setupSteps: Install this reviewed package release; installation does not provision any event delivery.
Publish the existing ONF HTTP listener through a reviewed HTTPS proxy preserving raw JSON bytes and required authentication headers.
Save the callback secret in Infrastructure → Secrets; create an ingress profile for this package requirement using HMAC SHA256 with X-Dropbox-Signature and empty prefix.
Bind the intended trigger node to that profile, save its provider filters, and deliberately enable both workflow and entry.
Enable GET query-echo challenge with query parameter challenge. Configure app secret as HMAC key and register the displayed HTTPS callback in the Dropbox App Console.
Authorize files.metadata.read for connected accounts. Downstream synchronization must retain a separate cursor per account and retrieve actual file changes; this trigger emits hints only.
Authorize a synthetic provider delivery and inspect its accepted run; HTTP 202 proves admission only. Review provider retries and downstream idempotency.

Select saved node entry mode webhook explicitly; package metadata does not infer it. Create/select a profile for this exact installed requirement (installation.id + "/account-changes"), bind node.trigger.ingress.profileId, save the graph and deliberately enable workflow and entry only when setup is complete.
